title: What is a wa.me link? — Linkly
snippet: It's the closest thing WhatsApp has to a "digital business card," and it's everywhere: support pages, Instagram bios, email signatures, packaging, billboards in São Paulo, posters in Mumbai, restaurant menus in Mexico City. If a business runs on WhatsApp, it almost certainly has a wa.me link somewhere. ... The phone number is in international format with no +, no spaces, and no dashes. Geographic routing — send US clicks to your US sales WhatsApp, EU clicks to your EU rep, with geo-redirect rules. A/B testing — split traffic across two wa.me destinations to see which pre-filled message converts better. A wa.me link is WhatsApp's official short URL for starting a conversation with a specific phone number. Click one and WhatsApp opens — on the app or the web — with a chat to that number ready to go. The text parameter is URL-encoded — spaces become , commas become ,, and so on. WhatsApp drops it into the message field; the user can edit before sending or just hit send.
